title: Pocketwire Business Profile Review and Negative-Balance Timings
content:
Three timings of the Pocketwire Business Profile, per tier: the calendar days after a review started within which the seller must submit review documents, the service target in business days for deciding submitted review documents, and the calendar days a business balance may stay negative before the shortfall is collected from the owner's personal balance. Column headings abbreviate the six tiers of the Pocketwire Business Profile: Pocketwire Business Starter, Pocketwire Business Essentials, Pocketwire Business Growth, Pocketwire Business Pro, Pocketwire Business Premier and Pocketwire Business Enterprise.

| | Starter | Essentials | Growth | Pro | Premier | Enterprise |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Review document window (calendar days after the review started) | 10 | 10 | 10 | 14 | 14 | 21 |
| Review decision service target (business days) | 5 | 5 | 5 | 3 | 3 | 2 |
| Negative balance allowed for (calendar days) | 30 | 30 | 30 | 45 | 45 | 60 |

The document window and the negative-balance period count calendar days; the decision target counts business days. On Pocketwire Business Enterprise, for example, the figures are 21 calendar days, 2 business days and 60 calendar days.
